teaser: The chair with the wobbling leg in the hospital waiting room is the one you take, every time, so whoever sits beside you gets the steady one. Life path 9 and an ISFJ temperament meet right there, without announcement: the number asks for care stretched toward everyone in the room, and the type already gives care to whoever happens to be nearest. The two habits fold into each other so easily that the fold itself can go unnoticed, until someone finally asks why you always take the broken chair and let the stranger have the good one.
excerpt: Three times at the farmers market stall, the same question comes back: are you buying for yourself, or for everyone who might stop by later?
